description: This file defines the PaymentAddress controller class for the checkout process in OpenCart. It handles viewing and saving customer payment address information, including address validation, address creation, and session management.

classes.name: PaymentAddress
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer's payment address during checkout, including address retrieval, validation, creation, and session management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the payment address form, pre-filling with existing addresses and data when available.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the submission of the payment address form; validates input, creates new address if needed, updates session data, and clears previous method selections.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a specific address based on provided address ID, or defaults if none provided.
